# ecoPrimals HUD — Human Universe Display
# https://hud.primals.eco
# SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-or-later

## What is this?

ecoPrimals is a sovereign distributed scientific computing ecosystem built entirely in Pure Rust. No CUDA. No cloud. No vendor lock-in. Everything runs on commodity hardware — including SteamOS.

The HUD (Human Universe Display) is the observation surface: a live membrane showing real-time data flows, research papers, GPU compute results, and ecosystem health.

## Key pages

- / — Main HUD dashboard. 341 entities, 131,322 connections, live observation.
- /water.html — The watering hole. Lazy river scroll-story. Onboarding, exploration, contribution.
- /banana.html — Self/non-self discrimination test. Are you a human?
- /weather.html — Real-time weather → music sonification. The sun writes the score.
- /aurora.html — AI-generated aurora visualization.
- /tools.html — 86 tools used in the ecosystem.
- /easel.html — Watch the chipmunk paint.
- /trail.html — The sporePrint path — all 117 research papers.
- /springs.html — Hot spring validation framework.
- /glyphs.html — Klein bottle topology — chipmunk speaks to families.
- /neutron/ — Neutron flow data and metrics.
- /neutron/helix.html — helixVision — sovereign AlphaFold protein structure prediction.
- /neutron/globe.html — 3D geographic footprint.
- /neutron/invite.html — Engineer invitation to try the tech.
- /desk/ — 12-panel mission desk.
- /live/ — Live membrane feeds.

## Research

117 research papers at https://sporeprint.primals.eco/science/
Topics: WebGPU/WGSL GPU compute, protein structure prediction, lattice QCD, molecular dynamics, pharmacometrics, bioinformatics, Shannon entropy phenotyping, Klein bottle topology, membrane computing, sovereign identity, zero-knowledge provenance.
